sun_spectrum.spectrum: CALSPEC sun_reference_stis_002 below 9600 Angstrom, sun_mod_001 from 9600 Angstrom (sun/README.md)
sun_spectrum.units: WAVELENGTH Angstrom (vacuum), FLUX erg/s/cm2/Angstrom at 1 AU
references: Bohlin, Gordon & Tremblay 2014, PASP 126, 711 (2014PASP..126..711B, doi:10.1086/677655): CALSPEC
Colina, Bohlin & Castelli 1996, AJ 112, 307 (doi:10.1086/118016): the solar reference spectrum

extinction.quantity: AfAv = A(lambda)/A(V) at the pivot wavelength
extinction.law: Fitzpatrick (1999) Milky Way R(V)-dependent extinction curve
extinction.normalisation: A(V) is the law's own normalisation, the extinction averaged over the V band: A(lambda)/A(V) = 1 at 5414 Angstrom and 0.978 at 5500 Angstrom (https://dust-extinction.readthedocs.io/en/latest/dust_extinction/normalization_details.html)
extinction.out_of_range: null where the pivot lies outside the implementation's F99.x_range; never extrapolated

properties_definitions.Fsun: band-averaged f_lambda of the Sun at 1 AU, integral(W S) / integral(W) with S the sun_spectrum and W the curve's detector-aware weight (T energy-counting, T*lambda photon-counting), trapezoidal rule on the curve's samples: the weight of ZeroPointVega_flam
properties_definitions.AfAv: A(lambda)/A(V) at lambda = WavelengthPivot from the extinction law (see extinction); dimensionless
properties_definitions.note: Vega quantities are null when the Vega spectrum does not cover the curve (where it transmits at least 1 % of its peak), Fsun likewise with the sun_spectrum. AfAv is null where the pivot lies outside the extinction law's valid range, or when dust_extinction is not installed (extinction.dust_extinction_version is then null).
properties_definitions.colors: DisplayColor is an sRGB hex for plotting (sed_tools.filter_colors). ColorMethod 'true': CIE D65 daylight seen through the curve, for bands with VisibleFraction (share of the throughput between 380 and 750 nm) of at least 0.5; 'false': ordered false colour for ultraviolet and infrared bands.

Fsun.meaning: SVO's band-averaged f_lambda of the Sun (CALSPEC sun_reference_stis_002 composed with sun_mod_001), the quantity NJM's properties.json gives as Fsun
Fsun.unit_source: SVO's VOTable: <PARAM name="Fsun" value="22.596337946016" unit="erg/cm2/s/A" ucd="phot.flux.density" datatype="double" > (2MASS/2MASS.H, Internet Archive capture 20250323174315 of http://svo2.cab.inta-csic.es/svo/theory/fps3/fps.php?ID=2MASS/2MASS.H); SVO's browse page: "Unit :erg/cm2/s/A UCD :phot.flux.density"
Fsun.precision: rounded as SVO's browse page displays it: 2 decimals from 1 up, 3 significant figures below 1

AfAv.meaning: SVO's A_f/A_V at its reference wavelength (the pivot): k(lambda)/k_V with k_V = 211.4, from SVO's opacity table for 'the extinction law by Fitzpatrick (1999) improved by Indebetouw et al (2005) in the infrared'. Not the law of NJM's AfAv (properties_definitions.extinction), so the two differ.
AfAv.unit_source: SVO's browse page shows the unit as ()
AfAv.precision: rounded as SVO's browse page displays it, to 3 significant figures

svo_instruments.method:
An SVO instrument (a ``Facility/Instrument`` group of SVO's current filter list) is
the same product as an NJM instrument when every one of its filter IDs is held in
that NJM instrument with the same curve.  NJM may hold more bands than SVO.
